subject.title: fix(web-shared): bound response.text() fallback to honor maxBytes

question: Should `readResponseText` fail closed for capped response-like objects that have no readable stream, even though the helper is exported through plugin SDK web helper barrels?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the behavior change replaces a compatibility fallback with a stricter bounded-read contract that existing provider/plugin code may observe.

options.title: Accept fail-closed helper behavior
options.body: Keep the latest branch behavior so capped calls without a bounded byte source return an empty truncated result instead of invoking whole-body fallbacks.

options.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
options.body: Revise the helper to keep a compatibility path and document why post-read allocation is acceptable for these response-like objects.

options.title: Pause for SDK contract review
options.body: Hold the PR until provider/plugin owners explicitly agree on the exported helper contract.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed helper behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the latest branch behavior so capped calls without a bounded byte source return an empty truncated result instead of invoking whole-body fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bounded helper lineage, is assigned, authored the latest branch commits, and posted the land-ready proof comment.
